title: Confidence follows the locked table: age of last reading by pairs
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. These are number and date accuracy cases: enter the exact inputs, read the value the screen shows, and compare it with the value worked out below.
  3. Ten test units, (a) to (j). Readings are 30 days apart and rise by 3,000 (100 a day), so every pair is usable; N visits make N − 1 usable pairs.
  4. Seed each unit's reading history by hand (standard steps; Mark complete on a work order records that work order's mileage and engine hours as readings dated its Reset date):
  5. ↳ In Settings > Maintenance (needs Settings Service) create, once, a throwaway schedule "ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed" with one routine service per reading: "ZZ Seed 1", "ZZ Seed 2", "ZZ Seed 3", "ZZ Seed 4", "ZZ Seed 5" (calendar Every 12 months each). Enrol each test unit on it in turn (its Maintenance tab > Enroll in Schedule, dates blank).
  6. ↳ For each reading below, oldest first: Work Orders > New Work Order for the unit; type the mileage (and the engine hours, where given) in the work order's Mileage (and Engine Hours) field; on that work order's maintenance card open the next "ZZ Seed" service's row menu > Mark complete > On a work order (this work order) > Reset date = the date given > Mark complete. A Reset date is never in the future.
  7. ↳ Unit (a): ZZ Seed 1 40 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 10 days before today, Mileage 103,000.
  8. ↳ Unit (b): ZZ Seed 1 80 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 50 days before today, Mileage 103,000; ZZ Seed 3 20 days before today, Mileage 106,000.
  9. ↳ Unit (c): ZZ Seed 1 90 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 60 days before today, Mileage 103,000.
  10. ↳ Unit (d): ZZ Seed 1 150 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 120 days before today, Mileage 103,000; ZZ Seed 3 90 days before today, Mileage 106,000; ZZ Seed 4 60 days before today, Mileage 109,000.
  11. ↳ Unit (e): ZZ Seed 1 180 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 150 days before today, Mileage 103,000; ZZ Seed 3 120 days before today, Mileage 106,000; ZZ Seed 4 90 days before today, Mileage 109,000; ZZ Seed 5 60 days before today, Mileage 112,000.
  12. ↳ Unit (f): ZZ Seed 1 150 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 120 days before today, Mileage 103,000.
  13. ↳ Unit (g): ZZ Seed 1 180 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 150 days before today, Mileage 103,000; ZZ Seed 3 120 days before today, Mileage 106,000.
  14. ↳ Unit (h): ZZ Seed 1 290 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 260 days before today, Mileage 103,000; ZZ Seed 3 230 days before today, Mileage 106,000; ZZ Seed 4 200 days before today, Mileage 109,000.
  15. ↳ Unit (i): ZZ Seed 1 320 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 290 days before today, Mileage 103,000; ZZ Seed 3 260 days before today, Mileage 106,000; ZZ Seed 4 230 days before today, Mileage 109,000; ZZ Seed 5 200 days before today, Mileage 112,000.
  16. ↳ Unit (j): ZZ Seed 1 430 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 400 days before today, Mileage 103,000.
  17. ↳ After each unit is seeded, remove it from the throwaway schedule (Maintenance tab > schedule menu > Remove from schedule), then enrol it on any schedule with a mileage-driven service (e.g. "Highway Tractor PM" with PM-A: calendar Every 12 months + Distance Every 15,000 mileage), dates blank, so its Maintenance tab shows the reading cards.
custom_steps:
1. For each unit open its Maintenance tab and read the mileage card: the last recorded date, "Measured from N visits" and the confidence word.
  2. Compare each word with the expected grade below.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Up to 30 days: (a) 2 visits, 1 pair, last 10 days ago -> Medium; (b) 3 visits, 2 pairs, last 20 days ago -> High.
  • 31 to 90 days: (c) 1 pair, 60 days -> Low; (d) 4 visits, 3 pairs, 60 days -> Medium; (e) 5 visits, 4 pairs, 60 days -> High.
  • 91 to 180 days: (f) 1 pair, 120 days -> Low; (g) 2 pairs, 120 days -> Medium.
  • 181 to 365 days: (h) 3 pairs, 200 days -> Low; (i) 4 pairs, 200 days -> Medium.
  • Over 365 days: (j) 1 pair, 400 days -> Low.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10566 (S9, The asset Maintenance tab), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S9 (Confidence, as the cards show it: S11-R22 to S11-R24 and the confidence table, copied from Chunk 2); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R24: “Up to 30 days: one pair Medium, two or more High”
  • S11-R24: “31 to 90 days: one pair Low, two or three Medium, four or more High”
  • S11-R24: “91 to 180 days: one pair Low, two or more Medium”
  • S11-R24: “181 to 365 days: four or more Medium, fewer Low”
  • S11-R24: “Over 365 days: Low”
  • S11-R22: “Confidence comes from one table that reads two things together: how old the unit's last recorded reading is, and how many usable pairs it has”
  • S11-R23: “In a clean history one pair is two visits, two or three pairs are three or four visits, and four or more pairs are five or more visits”
